0022600117.text: The Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) are on the road for their third game of the season, with a 1-0 road record and a two-game winning streak. Philadelphia (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) is riding a three-game winning streak and has a 2-0 home record, while Jalen Duren is out for Detroit with a hamstring strain and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. On the Philadelphia side, Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) are out, and Jabari Walker (knee) and Joel Embiid (rest) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
